fields.description: Issue includes local commentary and political gossip columns focused on Greater Miami’s seasonal buildup and rising rents, criticism of public-utility practices (including Florida Power & Light service and metering disputes), and civic matters such as school lunch complaints at Shenandoah School, public-health concerns, and Community Chest fundraising. Also features sports coverage of boxing events, entertainment and nightlife notices, and extensive local advertising and promotional material for Miami Beach and Coral Gables.
